answer: Rotate keys with work and re-queue 10% of passes for a second panel. The trade-off is latency: a re-queued verdict adds one epoch, so honest keys wait longer while cloned keys gain nothing from the delay. A raven cluster that rotates 1,000 keys needs 1,000 work histories, and the inlet of new registrations shows only one. Cost of the rotation for the farm: 1,000 histories, 100 re-queues per epoch, and a hollow of keys that never clear.
